paper.title: Can Network Theory-Based Targeting Increase Technology Adoption?

paper_reference.paper_question: 通过示范农户和网络传播促进技术采用，如何评估培训名单/政策？
paper_reference.target: 四户在“培训甲丙”和“培训乙丁”各1/2的随机政策下的平均采用率；四户等权。
paper_reference.source_location: Beaman et al. (2021) AER, DOI 10.1257/aer.20200295; project demo alignment only.
conditions: Two complete policy lists with known probabilities 1/2 each.
Full treatment vector randomized independently of potential outcomes.
what_paper_supports: Seed-farmer training and network diffusion as business context.
Policy/list comparisons need an explicit evaluation population and weights.
what_paper_does_not_support: No replication of the paper's diffusion model or optimal seeding.
No claim that the synthetic 1/2 policy is optimal.

missing_condition.reason: The two policy probabilities are omitted; the system stops with EXTENDED_NETWORK_FACTS_INCOMPLETE.

changed_target.reason: New pair of complete policies; requires fresh target binding.

actual_run.provenance: 2026-11-09 local structured run through the extended network finite-policy entry with explicit synthetic reviews; api_calls=0.
